scaffold: all 34 EnergyPlus 26.1 public material base/overlay objects and their source-owned order are inventoried. The bounded typed implementation covers Material, Material:NoMass, Material:AirGap, Material:InfraredTransparent, WindowMaterial:Glazing:RefractionExtinctionMethod, WindowMaterial:Glazing:EquivalentLayer, WindowMaterial:Gas, WindowMaterial:Gap:EquivalentLayer, WindowMaterial:GasMixture, WindowMaterial:Shade, WindowMaterial:Shade:EquivalentLayer, and WindowMaterial:Drape:EquivalentLayer plus only the SpectralAverage branch of WindowMaterial:Glazing; unsupported optical modes explicitly fail closed. RefractionExtinction preserves its raw n/k inputs and EnergyPlus 26.1 formula/visible-back quirk. Equivalent-layer glazing preserves all 26 numeric inputs, six bounded Autocalculate states, source defaults, and the SpectralAverage-only contract without adding optical-sum validation absent from its source block; its ignored spectral-dataset string is type-checked but not retained. Ordinary Gas resolves Air, Argon, Krypton, and Xenon to exact built-in constants after type/schema checking supplied custom fields; Custom preserves the three A+B*T+C*T^2 coefficient sets, validates positive 300 K conductivity and source/schema bounds, derives nominal resistance, and intentionally retains numeric zero for a missing specific-heat ratio. Equivalent-layer Gap reuses those gas records with its schema-distinct uppercase gas enum and required Sealed, VentedIndoor, or VentedOutdoor mode, without inventing the schema note's unenforced Air-only relationship. GasMixture encodes a one-to-four active prefix of standard-only gases, validates the schema-required Gas 1/Gas 2 pairs even for count 1, preserves missing active optional Gas 3/4 fractions as zero, and allows duplicate species and non-unit sums without normalization; nominal resistance uses only the first gas at 300 K. MaterialFamily separates opaque, ordinary fenestration, and equivalent-layer consumers. Ordinary Construction rejects equivalent-layer glazing, gaps, shades, and drapes because only the still-deferred Construction:WindowEquivalentLayer may consume them, while the bounded ordinary-window subset accepts exactly Glass ((Gas\|GasMixture) Glass){0..3}. Arbitrary-run support assessment explicitly counts and run-blocks the complete typed RefractionExtinction, all four EquivalentLayer objects, Gas, GasMixture, and ordinary Shade before execution. Existing material_opaque_variants_001, window_glazing_spectral_average_001, and window_glazing_refraction_extinction_001 provide only their declared nonblocking static EIO evidence. window_glazing_equivalent_layer_001 adds bounded external diagnostic evidence for the dedicated 18-token EIO row, and window_material_gas_001 adds duplicate-aware ordinary-window gas-layer occurrence evidence with exact EnergyPlus 26.1 {:.3R} thickness serialization. window_material_gap_equivalent_layer_001 adds a clean nonblocking exact seven-occurrence fixture sequence across all five gas types and all three vent modes, with one reused Argon material and one unused Air definition excluded; material name, canonical gas/vent type, and source-formatted thickness are exact. Construction names/declarations are aligned with converted-epJSON canonical order, so arbitrary IDF declaration-order parity remains unclaimed. EIO omits Custom coefficients/properties and nominal resistance. EnergyPlus emits no dedicated GasMixture construction-layer data row. window_material_gas_mixture_001 instead adds a nonblocking by-name gate for all six generic Material Details definition rows: identity, exactly-one multiplicity including the unused definition, MediumRough, source-{:.4R}-serialized thickness, and the fixed zero resistance, conductivity, density, specific-heat, and absorptance fields are exact. Its shared WindowMaterial:Gas header is exact and has zero data rows. The generic rows expose no mixture component count/species/fractions/order, nominal resistance, or occurrence/use/reuse status; two exact seven-layer WindowConstruction rows and host/window rows are oracle-only fixture locks. Construction:WindowEquivalentLayer typing/ratings, the source ASHWAT coefficient-copy/evaluation quirks, its construction-local sub-0.0001 m thickness replacement, window surfaces, optics/thermal behavior, runtime execution, and conformance remain unclaimed. Zero through 800 complete quartets are accepted, while an incomplete final quartet or excess point count fails closed. Each dataset is validated even when unused. Transmittance below 0.001 is silently replaced by 0.001; wavelength must remain in [0.1,4.0] microns and strictly increase; transmittance is at most 1.01; directional reflectances are in [0,1.02]; and transmittance plus either reflectance is at most 1.03.
